card.name: Words after "double" and dose reductions
card.fires_on: Small words right after "double" in missed-dose advice ("double the", "double up"). Also words in dose-adjustment phrases, such as "by" before a percentage reduction.

modes.label: The warning against doubling the dose
modes.description: The word "the" or "up" right after "double" in missed-dose instructions.
modes.example: Do notdouble<< the>> dose to make up for the missed dose

modes.label: Dose reduction phrasing
modes.description: A linking word before a percentage dose cut for kidney or liver impairment.
modes.example: Reduce dexrazoxane for injection dosage in patients with moderate to severe renal impairment (creatinine clearance values less than 40 mL/min)<< by>> 50% (dexrazox

modes.description: The word "dose" in instructions about taking the next dose after a miss.
